description.value: A voxel-based morphometry study examining associations among childhood adversity, alcohol use disorder, and adolescent brain volume.

spans.text: In the present voxel-based morphometry study (VBM), we extended our analysis of a cohort of adolescents from the Cape Town area of South Africa, with no other psychiatric comorbidities or other substance abuse, to focus in more detail on the link between childhood adversity, AUD and structural brain abnormalities.

left hippocampal volume negatively correlated with CTQ scores

value: Left hippocampal volume negatively correlated with CTQ scores, specifically physical neglect, emotional neglect, physical abuse, emotional abuse, sexual abuse and total CTQ. Right hippocampal volumes also correlated negatively with emotional neglect, sexual abuse and total CTQ score.

spans.text: Further, left hippocampal volume negatively correlated with CTQ scores, specifically physical neglect (Rho −0.22,   p   = 0.01), emotional neglect (Rho −0.19,   p   = 0.01), physical abuse (Rho −0.21, p0.01), emotional abuse (Rho −0.23, p0.01), sexual abuse (Rho −0.23, p0.01) and total CTQ (Rho −0.31,   p   = 0.01). Right hippocampal volumes also correlated with CTQ scores, namely, emotional neglect (Rho −0.16,   p   = 0.01), sexual abuse (Rho −0.16,   p   = 0.01) and total CTQ score (Rho −0.21,   p   = 0.01).
